items.title: November 08, 2026
items.summary: Google SecOps SOARAnnouncementRelease 6.3.106 is being rolled out to the first phase of regions as listedhere.FeatureCase activity taggingYou can now use custom tags for individual activities, comments, tasks, andactions on the Case Wall, and filter the wall view by those tags. This allowsyou to categorize specific observations and filter the timeline to view only theentries relevant to your investigation or team.For more information, see Add a tag to a Case Wall activity.
